Sometimes I can be a bit of a fangirl...

Chris came through Denver with the Oddball Comedy Tour last summer. I knew there was a chance that Chris would fly privately (he did, I believe he flew with Louis CK- he had just started talking about that on the podcast) but I also knew there was a chance he would come through DIA. So, yes, I hung out at the airport for a few hours that morning.

I know. I'm a geek. Some other time I'll tell you how I drove from Boulder to Salt Lake to see him do stand up. It's a great story!
I feel like he would have been super appreciative of this but also way embarrassed.

I saw standing there and someone started taking pictures of me. It kind of weirded me out until I realized it was Hannibal Burress. He came over and told me he was sorry but Chris had flown privately, but he sent him the pics. :)

I think the biggest thing on his mind that day, though, was the fact that he was playing Red Rocks. That was super cool for most of the people on the tour, and Chris was talking about it for weeks before the gig.
